title: ContentConfig
description: Which languages the content bundle carries. The pipeline gates (G-BILINGUAL, G-MERGE) and the app's language UI both read this. Adding a language here without content for it fails the build; that is the point.

contentVersion.description: YYYY.MM.N — bumped by hand on every content change. Pinned here, never derived from the clock, so a re-run is byte-reproducible.

languages.description: Languages every shipped question MUST carry. Gate G-BILINGUAL checks each.

plannedLanguages.description: Languages the schema reserves a slot for but which are not yet shipped. Must not overlap `languages`.

decision.description: Why the language set is what it is. A language cut is a product decision and must be recorded where the config lives, not only in a doc.
